english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an electric light bulb.
Use this for the light bulb itself, rather than the whole lamp or light fitting.

examples.english: This bulb is about to burn out.
examples.jyutping: ni1 nap1 dang1 daam2 zau6 lai4 waai6 laa3

examples.english: The lamp bulb has blown, so I need to buy a new one.
examples.traditional: 個燈膽燒咗，我要買個新嘅。
examples.jyutping: go3 dang1 daam2 siu1 zo2 ngo5 jiu3 maai5 go3 san1 ge3
